notes: Phase 30 D PROOF-OF-PATTERN convergence study. Three structured-quad mesh refinements (10x10, 20x20, 40x40). Each entry produced by a live ccx 2.23 run (2026-05-18). S4 shell elements with Mindlin thick-shell kinematics. Analytical reference is Timoshenko's a^4 coefficient series (alpha~0.00406 at nu=0.3). Phase 31 C adds Richardson extrapolation (post-processing; no new live ccx run).

richardson.notes: Phase 31 C: Richardson extrapolation on the 3-point sweep (h ratio = 2 over each step, constant). Observed order p~2.48 is the empirical convergence order — close to but distinct from S4's theoretical p=2 for bending; the +1.31% extrapolated residual CONFIRMS the Phase 30 D finding that the S4 + Mindlin thick-shell discretisation has a ~+1.2% ASYMPTOTIC bias against Timoshenko's analytical series. Under-refinement is NOT the cause of the +1.17% residual at n=40; the bias persists as h->0. Sign of the analytical reference was inverted to align with the observed convention (.frd uz > 0 vs Timoshenko series < 0) so the residual is computed in the same direction as the existing residual_pct field.
